config.inference_rule: raw primary; fixed per-task mean subtraction diagnostic
config.precision: FP32 deterministic algorithms, math SDPA, TF32 off

limitations: single development seed; no significance claim
current-input KL is not an old-task risk guarantee
shape correction does not guarantee classification improvement
active rank per task is fixed; task-boundary merges are shared with control
original LoRM is a system comparison; eta-zero arm is the matched comparison
Fixed client rank8 FP32 factors replace full gradient messages; spectra and loss do not certify generalization.
Candidate gradient and primary gate use all-seen CE plus old KL; client training still uses current CE plus old KL. Current-loss guard is training-internal, not old-image safety.
Training-internal loss gate is not a held-out or old-task risk guarantee; extra forward and logical communication costs are reported.
